title: communication.sms.send
description: Triggered when the store sends an SMS message. Generated from https://docs.salla.dev/webhook-events/communciation-apps (fetched 2026-10-26).

event.description: The webhook topic that fired. Determines whether the payload relates to an outgoing SMS or email.

merchant.description: Merchant ID of the store that triggered the webhook. Use this ID to look up the merchant’s details via the documented endpoint [here](https://docs.salla.dev/9466620e0).

created_at.description: Time the webhook was generated by Salla (server time).

notifiable.description: Target recipients for the message: phone numbers for SMS or email addresses for email. Maximum 500 campaign sms notifiable are allowed.

type.description: Business event for which the message was sent (see enum for the full catalog).

content.description: Rendered message body. For order-related emails, this may be empty (content is often contained in the email template itself).
content.title: Message content
examples: لقد حصلت على 1000 نقاط ولاء جديدة في حسابك 🔔

id.description: ID of the related business entity, e.g., an order ID for order events.

type.description: Type of the related business entity, e.g., an order for order events.

entity.description: Context object for the event’s primary entity (may be null if not applicable).

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who is being notified.

meta.description:
A key-value map of additional metadata related to the notification.
Useful for providing extended context or computed details that are not included in the entity field.
